verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a daily event quota with a choice of overage handling: 'capture every event' or 'rate limiting'. Rate limiting caps intake at the quota, and controls over which events count toward it, including discard rules synced to the SDKs, help keep spend predictable. Nothing in the evidence shows quotas capped per project or an explicit dollar spend limit. Missing for 10: per-project quota caps, explicit spend-limit/budget controls, independent corroboration of overage behavior during error storms.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice

citations.quote: We provide two options for handling daily event quota overages, _capture every event_ and _rate limiting_.
Take control over which events we save and count towards your event quota.
Remote SDK Source-Side Discard Enforcement now syncs active dashboard discard rules directly to upgraded Android and iOS SDKs
